exact_target.label: lem:etale-collars
hypotheses: k is a finite extension of Q_p; bar k is an algebraic closure; Omega is its algebraically closed complete completion.
The additive valuation is v=-log_p(abs(.)), with v(Omega^*)=Q.
ell is an odd prime different from p.
C/bar k is smooth, proper, connected, and has genus at least two.
The finitely many b_i are distinct algebraic points of C.
The B_i are disjoint sufficiently small coordinate disks about b_i; t_i is defined over bar k and vanishes simply at b_i.
exact_target.conclusion: One connected finite etale cover Y -> C_Omega and one concentric open subcollar A_i' inside each B_i, with positive distinct ground-value-group radii, such that t_i has an analytic ell-th root on the entire inverse image of A_i' in Y^an.
not_asserted: A root on each original whole disk or on a prescribed fixed-radius collar.
Only one selected inverse sheet or only a skeleton root.
Roots of order divisible by p.
Patching, L_ell subset H, the completion theorem, or a section conjecture.

claim_assessments.decisive_argument: Inverse unit reductions on each rational-radius Laurent circle force a unique dominant coefficient term. A change of exponent forces a forbidden rational-radius tie. Compact-subannulus convergence extends the same dominant monomial across the whole open annulus. Integral binomial coefficients for 1/ell give compatible locally uniformly convergent roots of 1+h. Algebraic closedness roots the constant; a root of S roots S^d.
edge_cases_checked: Disk-unit norm lies in the ground value group by evaluation at an Omega-point.
Open-annulus factorization is proved, not simply quoted from a closed-annulus proposition.
Pointwise abs(h)<1 suffices through compact-subannulus bounds; a global strict supremum bound is not assumed.
Negative and zero Laurent exponents are allowed.
On the annulus itself a root exists exactly when ell divides the Laurent exponent.

claim_assessments.manuscript_locator: P/build/sections/04-tame-roots.tex, residue-cover constructions in the proof of lem:stable-edge-root
claim_assessments.decisive_argument: Divisibility of Pic^0(D) gives div(f)=P-Q+ell E. Kummer normalization has exact degree ell because the orders at P,Q are nonzero modulo ell; these are its only tame branch points. For positive genus, a line bundle of exact order ell gives a finite etale cyclic algebra whose nontrivial degree-zero summands have no global sections, proving connectedness.
edge_cases_checked: The two-mark ramified construction works in genus zero without nonzero Jacobian torsion.
Torsion is used only for positive genus.
All other marked fibres contain ell distinct points.
The ramified genus is ell*g(D); the etale genus is ell*(g(D)-1)+1.
Actual residue maps are constructed, so no numerical-profile Hurwitz existence condition is left open.

dependencies: Universal graph and ramification arithmetic; compiler review is parent-owned.
claim_assessments.decisive_argument: On a simple circuit use the two-mark ramified residue covers, factor-ell circuit edges, and factor-one edges representing all other marked fibres. Riemann-Hurwitz gives zero augmented ramification and stability weights scale by ell. For a bridge each side has a circuit or positive genus; connected unramified degree-ell covers of the sides glue through ell factor-one edges, each nonseparating after deletion of any one. Apply the circuit construction to all these lifts and combine through connected finite-etale fibre-product components.
claim_assessments.whole_inverse_image_argument: ABBR's exact inverse-skeleton equality prevents complementary source balls mapping to the skeleton. Each such ball maps into a single target ball, and continuity maps its end to the unique target attachment point. Retractions commute, so the entire inverse node annulus is the union of the prescribed source annuli. Their pulled-back coordinate exponents are plus or minus ell, and the unit lemma supplies roots throughout them.
edge_cases_checked: Self-loops have two distinct marks on the same residue normalization.
Chords and noncircuit loops have all unramified marked fibres represented.
The genus-zero-tree side of a bridge is impossible by 2N-1 versus 3N.
A positive-genus tree side uses a connected etale residue cover rather than a nonexistent graph circuit.
The precover triangulation remains stable.
Every connected fibre-product component dominates each connected factor.
The proof works for arbitrary finite stable graphs and finite families of node annuli, not just the finite ell=3 illustration.

claim_assessments.manuscript_locator: P/build/sections/04-tame-roots.tex, irrational-level and compact-window argument inside lem:etale-collars
dependencies: Universal compact-space exclusion; formal statement and compiler review are parent-owned.
claim_assessments.decisive_argument: In the compact inverse of a rational closed annular window, every point outside the finite union of source node tubes has rational pulled-back coordinate valuation. Generic reductions give type-2 vertices and rational values; smooth reductions give whole disk tubes mapping into the target annulus, where the coordinate unit has constant rational valuation; node reductions are already in the selected union. The closed bad set has compact real-valued image contained in Q. It avoids an irrational interior level, hence avoids a whole rational-endpoint interval.
edge_cases_checked: The smooth disk tubes need not be a finite family.
Functorial reduction is used for the entire disk tube, not just an individual point.
The RNS cover may have wild reduction.
The model morphism need not be finite.
The conclusion is f^-1(A') subset N, not an inverse-skeleton equality for this cover.
Off-skeleton analytic points are included.
The radii are p^(-q_plus)<p^(-q_minus), with order reversed.
claim_assessments.formal_boundary: The compact-space implication does not prove its analytic rationality and model-reduction hypotheses. Those are supplied mathematically by the preceding argument.

claim_assessments.decisive_argument: Finite descent and blowups at smooth sections create target node annuli inside all prescribed disks. The ratio t_i/u_i is a disk unit of constant ground-group norm, so these annuli are concentric for t_i. RNS gives a stable-source etale cover mapping to the specified modified model. Capture puts every inverse point of smaller collars inside finitely many stable source node annuli. A common connected finite-etale cover roots all their coordinates, hence all the pulled-back t_i units. Restricting those roots gives the entire-inverse-image conclusion.
edge_cases_checked: No descent of an arbitrary infinite analytic expression for t_i is needed.
The target model may be semistable and not stable, but is proper, flat, normal, and of finite presentation.
Geometric connected-component selection and splitting reduction preserve the required model morphism.
The stable source has genus at least two by unramified Riemann-Hurwitz.
The original cover's unit slopes can be any integers.
Disjoint node tubes require no compatibility gluing of independently chosen roots.
A single cover handles the finite collection.

required_hypotheses: Affinoid closed annular windows and proper separated algebraic curve analytifications.

source_attributions.application_match: Proper analytifications and closed windows are compact Hausdorff. The closed bad set has compact real-valued image. Type 2 implies relative rational rank zero; the value-group quotient is torsion. Within R, n*gamma rational implies gamma rational. This derives the required rational values rather than attributing them to the word vertex.

source_attributions.application_match: Surjectivity of multiplication by ell gives the divisor class for two-mark ramified covers in every genus. Nonzero ell-torsion gives a connected etale cyclic residue cover only when genus is positive. Standard Picard, Kummer, and Riemann-Hurwitz arguments complete these constructions; they are not falsely attributed to Theorem 8.2 itself.
